headline: Approved Stephanie Call as secretary, new monthly meeting start times, and emailing members all important correspondence.
summary: Members approved the June minutes, Stephanie Call as secretary, and changes to future meeting times. They also approved emailing all members important correspondence. Discussion of the chair and co-chair roles and of AI in grant applications was continued to future meetings.
decisions: Approved the June 1st, 2026 meeting minutes; the matter passed.
Approved Stephanie Call as the next SCC secretary; the vote was unanimous.
Continued the chair and co-chair discussion to the next month.
Approved the future meeting time changes; the vote was unanimous.
Approved a motion that all members be emailed all important correspondence; the vote was unanimous.
Continued the discussion of whether AI should be allowed in grant applications or funded projects to the August meeting.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to vote on June meeting by Ian, seconded by Stephanie. ... Matter passed.
Cris motions for Stephanie to become next secretary, Ian seconds motion. All voted yes, matter unanimously passed.
Chair/co-chair discussion to be continued next month.
Cris makes motion for the above time changes, Cassandra seconds this motion. Matter unanimously passes.
Cris motions for all members to be emailed all important correspondences. Jess seconds motion. Matter passes unanimously.
Discussion: AI a. Whether or not AI should be allowed in grant applications or funded projects. b. To be continued in August meeting.
